name: Canopy Counter / Bar Top – Custom Portable Countertop for Canopy Tents
descriptionHtml:
Canopy Counter / Bar Top

Upgrade your canopy setup with our Canopy Counter / Bar Top, the perfect addition for food vendors, trade shows, and outdoor events. Designed for functionality and style, this durable counter provides a convenient surface for serving, displaying products, or engaging with customers.

💪Durable Construction: Built with sturdy materials to support heavy use during events and exhibitions.

⚙️Easy Installation: Attaches securely to your canopy frame in minutes — no tools required.

📏Perfect Fit: Custom-designed to fit most standard 10x10 and 10x15 canopy frames.

🎨Customizable Surface: Available in multiple finishes and branding options for a professional look.

🚚Portable & Lightweight: Easy to transport, set up, and store with your existing canopy gear.

🎯Multi-Purpose Use: Ideal for serving food, displaying merchandise, or using as a checkout counter at events.

Dimensions:

110.5" L x 36" H x 14" D

Fits 10’ Canopies - 9’ 2.5” L x 14” D

2 Height Settings

  • 36” Counter Height
  • 42” Bar Height

Materials:

3 Sturdy Steel Support Legs

Customize Banner with Your Logo or Branding

Primary Usage:
Trade shows, food booths, vendor markets, outdoor bars, and branded events
